messages:
maya: Quick async check-in for canary slice 7 — short format: what I did / blockers / today.

maya: What I did: kicked off slice7 at 03:20 UTC (2% traffic), verified deploys across region-us-west-2, warmed caches.
maya: Blockers: saw a small spike in transient 502s on frontend-agg (3 occurrences) — root cause unclear, possibly probe timeout.
maya: Today: monitoring for 30m, will decide on bump to 5% at t+45 if p95 < 250ms and errors < 0.5%.

chen: Thanks — saw the 502s, digging into proxy timeouts now. I have a fix branch (pr 4821) to extend idle timeout for the load balancer.
chen: If that branch looks good, can we patch to slice nodes without full redeploy?

samir: @chen you can toggle the ALB config via infra-console, but patching only to slice instances is risky. Prefer rolling update on slice nodes.

ops-bot: deploy: slice-7 v2.3.1 deployed to us-west-2 at 03:20:12 UTC. health: 12/12 passing. alerts: none.

jordan: Quick metrics snapshot (last 5m):
```
req/s: 420
p50: 68ms
p95: 225ms
errors: 0.42% (mostly 502)
```

lia: Dashboards warming: I added a temporary comparison panel for slice7 vs baseline-1, link: https://wavefront.company/dashboards/slice7-compare
lia: Alert threshold set to p95 > 350ms or errors > 1% (notify #eng-oncall + POV)

samir: FYI PR 4821 reviewed, left one comment about backoff. @maya if you want faster mitigation, I can merge and trigger a slice-only rolling update.

maya: Merge and roll if you're confident — prioritize no user-visible errors. Also @jordan can you run `curl -v` against a few sample requests and paste traces?

jordan: ran 3 traces, attaching quick snippet:
```
> GET /generate
< 200 OK
x-request-id: rq-7a2
latency: 214ms
```

chen: Merged pr 4821 and initiated rolling update on slice7 nodes at 03:34 UTC. Rolling 3 at a time.

ops-bot: rolling-update: slice-7: started at 03:34:12 UTC. progress: 3/12

maya: Current plan: wait 20 minutes post-rolling update, re-evaluate metrics, then bump to 5% if stable. If errors persist, rollback to v2.3.0 and open incident.

lia: I'll keep the dashboard link pinned and add a runbook note in case of rollback.

samir: pinged oncall for heads-up. I'll be on standby to revert if needed.

maya: Thanks all. Action items summarized:
- chen: finish rolling update and report progress
- jordan: paste more traces if you see anything abnormal
- lia: keep dashboards + alerting
- samir: oncall handoff + PR merge oversight

maya: I'll post another quick update at t+20m. :thumbsup:
